The biggest issue is losing your work. One accidental tap on the Back button can instantly erase one or two hours of careful work, with no warning and no way to recover it. This has happened to me several times, and everything I carefully created simply disappeared in a second.

reviews.title: Charged My Card Even Though I Canceled Before the Trial Ended
reviews.text:
I downloaded the app on the 2nd, looked around, and decided the very next day that it wasn’t for me. I followed the cancellation instructions exactly and received a confirmation email on the 3rd confirming that my subscription had been canceled.

According to their own terms, I needed to cancel by the 5th to avoid being charged the $6.99 monthly subscription fee on the 6th. I canceled two days before that deadline.

Then, on the 13th, I received an email saying they had charged my card on the 6th anyway.

I have already filed a dispute with my credit card company because this charge was not authorized. Requiring users to sign up for a free trial just to use the app is one thing, but charging them after they’ve properly canceled and received confirmation is unacceptable.

Based on my experience, I’d be very cautious before signing up. Keep your cancellation confirmation emails just in case.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text:
This app used to be perfect, exactly everything I needed for instagram and social media posts. I rarely ever used any of the fancy frames or border effects, sticking with simple grids.

This morning I opened SCRL to make a post, and to my surprise, the simple grids which I’ve used forever (these have always been free) are now locked behind a premium paywall. Only the most simple grids are now available without a subscription.

I understand charging for more advanced features and premium templates, but requiring premium for simple things is absurd. 

Not to mention, this is only available under monthly or yearly subscriptions, no one time purchase.

I am heavily considering going back to photoshop as I’m not about to get hosed with another subscription.

Developers, if you are reading this: Please do not require premium for the grids that we’ve been able to use forever.

Also, I think I’m not alone in wanting a one time purchase option. I would love to support and compensate you for your app, but I am not signing up for monthly payments when I am not even using the new updated features.
